blocks: ## D1 - the questions, by write session (FR-001, FR-002)

decisions.summary: Four write page sessions of at most four questions each, one check-and-apply session, then the #9 note; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: Mechanics of carrying out FR-001..FR-005; narrows nothing the request asked.

decisions.summary: make page-session with five briefs; the passes are leads and each passage is read on its page before it is cited.
decisions.why: How the research is done; strengthens rather than narrows.

decisions.summary: Morisada searched by NDL full-text with the viewer's request body for pids 991466/991467, each hit read on a screenshot; 402's tools reused.
decisions.why: Method for the Morisada leads the request lists (#3, #4, #7); covers both volumes.

decisions.summary: 高岡史料 (pid 899935) read by IIIF frames, else the viewer; if both refuse, recorded as an unread lead, dated.
decisions.why: Contingent narrowing whose only trigger is NDL physically refusing both routes; reading is impossible in that case, and FR-004 already anticipates leads closed as not publicly readable.

decisions.summary: Bochum chapter spreadsheets and the scanned original consulted to settle the per-li label before Zhili freight is written.
decisions.why: Serves the request's 1769 物料价值则例 fares lead.

decisions.summary: Each new figure sits beside the craftsman's and unskilled laborer's day wage of the same place and period, or the wage is marked SILENT with the nearest named (class, place, unit, gap).
decisions.why: An addition of context to the research being finished, not a narrowing of any lead.

decisions.summary: No performance bookends: no generator change.
decisions.why: Follows from FR-005.

decisions.summary: XII research:physical tasks, XIII record checks green, XVI built as the FRs.
decisions.why: Restates standing rules; narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: 0259/0262/0264/0265: Morisada inns, sake and soba (koma 228 handbill transcribed or named), paper and ink SILENT with the search, rent's system and fees.
decisions.why: Carries the request's Morisada hatago, soba, sake, paper-and-ink and rents leads; a SILENT result is written with the dated search that found nothing, which is finishing the lead, not dropping it.

decisions.summary: Gamble's Beijing series into 0250, 0266 and 0265's wage line; the 1921 survey's gild wages where a craftsman's Beijing wage is needed; Zhili freight after the label is settled.
decisions.why: Carries Gamble's Qing cash wages and the 1769 fares leads; the 1921 survey is an added source serving the wage context.

decisions.summary: 0261's sewing and used kimono marked SILENT with Morisada's search named.
decisions.why: Carries the Morisada sewing and used-clothing leads; ground (a named search that found nothing) is stated. Treated consistently with the other SILENT entries.

decisions.summary: 'the cotton series soybeans' - Mitsui Bunko's Osaka cotton series lead is answered with soybean figures.
decisions.why: The request lists Mitsui Bunko's Osaka COTTON series. On the plain reading the plan writes soybeans from it and says nothing of cotton, with no ground stated (not public, not in the series, misidentified lead). One label is stretched over two commodities. Fix: one sentence saying what is written for the cotton figures themselves, or on what ground (with the pass that found it) the cotton lead is closed and why soybeans stand in.

decisions.summary: 'Koyaizu NDL-only' for 『近世賃金物価史史料』.
decisions.why: Narrows the lead either way - restricts where it is searched, or closes it as in-library-only - and the plan does not say which or why. If the ground is that the book is readable only inside NDL, that is physical impossibility and FR-004's 'closed as not publicly readable' category, and would be LEGITIMATE; as a bare label there is nothing to find legitimate. Fix: state that it is closed as not publicly readable (with the evidence: NDL access status, date), or that it will be read and where.

decisions.summary: 0256/0257/0268/0269: #6's absence notes name the search; Hasegawa 1987 and 「近江の石工たち」 retried; 湯浅隆, 御再建場所日記, KAKEN 19K15191 read if public or named.
decisions.why: Carries the #6 修理見積 leads (roof finishes, roofer-days, mason wages, porterage); the 'read if public or named' rule states its ground (public readability) and matches FR-004's closed-as-not-publicly-readable category.

decisions.summary: 0270: 高岡史料's 関野神社 section and p. 590 read; the mirror SILENT in Morisada.
decisions.why: Carries #7's Morisada mirror lead (SILENT with search) and reads the published Takaoka source.

decisions.summary: 'Okamoto papers named' - the Takaoka donor's own records are named rather than read.
decisions.why: The request's lead is 'the Takaoka donor's own records'. The plan names them instead of reading them with no ground stated, unlike s3's explicit 'read if public or named'. Fix: same as Koyaizu - state that they are read if publicly readable, or closed as not publicly readable with the evidence and date.

decisions.summary: The 宿村大概帳 Tokaido tariffs lead appears in no session row, and the block closes with 'Nothing else in these pages changes.'
decisions.why: The request names the 宿村大概帳 Tokaido tariffs among #3's leads. The s1 cell is 'Morisada: inns...' and 宿村大概帳 is not Morisada; no other row names it, and the closing sentence makes the omission operative. A lead dropped by omission with no ground is the failure this review exists for. Fix: name the question it goes into and what happens to it - tariffs read and written, SILENT with the search named, or closed as not publicly readable with the evidence.

decisions.summary: Nothing else in the thirteen pages changes.
decisions.why: Scope limit consistent with FR-001/FR-005, apart from the 宿村大概帳 omission it makes operative (ruled separately).

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md holds one line per changed question.
decisions.why: Carries FR-003.

decisions.summary: Comment on EliAndrewC/diagram#9 naming changed files, changed verdicts, closed leads and what is still open.
decisions.why: Carries FR-004 word for word.

decisions.summary: Page sessions, implementation check, note, then report and land by the direct route.
decisions.why: Sequencing only.

blocks: ## D1 - the questions, by write session (FR-001, FR-002)

decisions.summary: Thirteen questions in four write sessions (s1 0259/0262/0264/0265; s2 0250/0260/0261/0266; s3 0256/0257/0268/0269; s4 0270), every lead of request.md placed in a row
decisions.why: The union is exactly FR-001's thirteen ids. Request walk: Morisada hatago -> s1 0259; soba, sake -> s1 0262; sewing and used clothing -> s2 0261; paper/ink -> s1 0264; rents -> s1 0265; 宿村大概帳 -> s1 0259 and s2 0260; Mitsui cotton and Koyaizu -> s2 0261; Gamble's Qing wages -> s2 0250/0266/0265 wage line; 1769 fares -> s2 Zhili freight (Bochum label); #6 temple-repair estimates -> s3; mirror and Takaoka donor -> s4 0270. Nothing dropped.

decisions.summary: The Tokaido tariffs lead closed as not publicly readable (print edition NDL in-library only, manuscript the sole copy, no digitized copy), named in 0259's and 0260's absence notes; the tariffs already cited stand
decisions.why: Reading the source from here is physically impossible on the stated, dated ground (passes/other-leads.md, 2026-10-19), and FR-004 itself names 'the leads closed as not publicly readable' as a class the asker is told of. The lead is closed by being searched and named, which finishes the task rather than skipping it.

decisions.summary: Mitsui Bunko's Osaka cotton series: nothing written; the 1757 Mitsui series is soybeans, and the books holding any cotton series are login or in-library only; closed and named in 0261's note
decisions.why: Two grounds, judged separately: the series the lead pointed at is not a cotton series (the requested thing is not where the lead said), and the books that could hold one are not publicly readable (physical impossibility). Neither is a preference.

decisions.summary: No soybean figure is written from the Mitsui series
decisions.why: The GM asked for cotton; declining to add an unrequested soybean series keeps scope inside the request.

decisions.summary: 『近世賃金物価史史料』 closed as not publicly readable (NDL pid 14107062 in-library only), named in 0261's note, cited at second hand
decisions.why: Physically unreadable from here on a stated, dated ground; the lead is searched, named and closed in the manner FR-004 anticipates.

decisions.summary: The Takaoka donor's records (岡本家文書): s4 searches once more and reads a public copy if found, otherwise names them as not found online, dated
decisions.why: The closure is conditional on there being no public copy after a further search, so it applies only where reading is impossible; the work the request asks for is still done.

decisions.summary: #6: absence notes name the search; Hasegawa 1987 and 「近江の石工たち」 retried; 湯浅隆, 御再建場所日記, KAKEN 19K15191 read if public, else named
decisions.why: Same structure as Okamoto: the condition for not reading is public availability itself, so the carve-out reaches only the physically impossible case; an absence note recording a completed search is the finished research, not a skipped one.

decisions.summary: 高岡史料 関野神社 section and p. 590 read by IIIF, else the viewer, else recorded as an unread lead, dated
decisions.why: The last step fires only when both access routes refuse, i.e. when reading is impossible; it is dated as the figures contract asks.

decisions.summary: 0261 sewing and used kimono, 0264 paper and ink, 0270 mirror recorded SILENT with Morisada's search named
decisions.why: The request asked for Morisada to be searched for these; recording a negative search result with its method is the search finished.

decisions.summary: Each new figure sits beside same-place, same-period craftsman and laborer day wages, or names the wage SILENT and the nearest with class, place, unit and gap; the 1921 survey's gild wages where a Beijing craftsman's wage is needed
decisions.why: The money skill's standing rule (research/money-requests.md), applied to the requested figures; it enforces how the requested answers are written rather than adding new work.

decisions.summary: Zhili freight written after the Bochum per-li label is settled from the spreadsheets and the scanned original
decisions.why: This is the 1769 物料价值则例 fares lead; settling the unit before citing is part of reading it.

decisions.summary: s2 edits 0265's wage line after s1; s5 check-and-apply; page-session cap of four; passes read on the page before citing; Morisada via NDL full-text and screenshots; implementation-check line per question (D2); note on #9 (D3); order and direct landing (T); constitution check; performance N/A; nothing else in these pages changes
decisions.why: Process and method inside FR-002..FR-005; no scope added or removed.
